meta.title: 搞副业前先问自己：三个前提都满足了吗
meta.title_en: Three Prerequisites Before Starting a Side Hustle

scenes.title_en: The side hustle that sank the day job
scenes.context: 讲者开场点出副业常见悲剧：还没赚到钱先把主业搞没了，并提醒先端好饭碗。
sentences: 终于下定决心开始搞副业，实现了从0到1的突破，接下来就是悲剧了。
You finally decide to start a side hustle, break through from zero to one — and that's where the trouble begins.
从0到1：from zero to one
搞着搞着，还没赚到钱，把主业给搞没了。
You grind away, earn nothing yet, and lose your main job in the process.
把主业搞没了：lose the day job
如果公司还能按时给你发工资，你应该抱有一颗感恩的心，先把手里的饭碗端好。
If your company still pays you on time, be grateful and keep a firm grip on your current job.
端好饭碗：keep your job safe
paraphrase: A side hustle isn't a win just because you start it.
Secure the day job before chasing the side hustle.
scenes.speak: You finally decide to start a side hustle, break through from zero to one — and that's where the trouble begins. You grind away, earn nothing yet, and lose your main job in the process. If your company still pays you on time, be grateful and keep a firm grip on your current job.

scenes.context: 讲者给出搞副业的三个前提：主业无敌、时间复用、激励相容。
sentences: 主业无敌才能搞副业，就是主业已经没有什么能难到你了。
You can only take on a side hustle when your main job no longer challenges you.
主业无敌：master your main job
你花在副业上的所有时间，都可以给你主业带来直接的结果和好处。
Every hour you spend on the side hustle should deliver direct value back to your main job.
时间复用：reuse your time
副业搞好了就能促进主业，主业搞好了又能反过来促进副业，形成飞轮效应。
A good side hustle boosts your main job, and a strong main job boosts the side hustle — a flywheel effect.
飞轮效应：flywheel effect
paraphrase: 主业不稳 → 副业就位
A shaky main job can't support a side hustle.
时间复用 → 主副双赢
Reused time makes both jobs win.
scenes.speak: You can only take on a side hustle when your main job no longer challenges you. Every hour you spend on the side hustle should deliver direct value back to your main job. A good side hustle boosts your main job, and a strong main job boosts the side hustle — a flywheel effect.

scenes.context: 讲者以自己拍视频为例说明副业反哺主业，最后要求先在纸面推导逻辑闭环再开始。
sentences: 我一个人就是一支队伍，编剧、剧本、灯光、收音、字幕、剪辑全包。
I'm a one-man crew: writing, scripting, lighting, audio, subtitles, and editing.
一支队伍：a one-man crew
我在主业上犯过的错、踩过的坑，都是我将来副业变现的资产。
Every mistake I made and pitfall I hit in my day job is an asset for my future side hustle.
变现的资产：assets to cash in on
先在纸面上把时间复用、激励相容推导出来，找不出任何逻辑漏洞，才能开始搞副业。
Work out the logic of time reuse and mutual incentives on paper first — start only when there's no hole in the reasoning.
逻辑漏洞：a hole in the reasoning
paraphrase: The day job feeds the side hustle.
Reason it out before you commit.
scenes.speak: I'm a one-man crew: writing, scripting, lighting, audio, subtitles, and editing. Every mistake I made and pitfall I hit in my day job is an asset for my future side hustle. Work out the logic of time reuse and mutual incentives on paper first — start only when there's no hole in the reasoning.

practice: Keep a firm grip on your current job.
Reuse your time so it pays off in both jobs.
The two feed each other like a flywheel.
Prove the logic on paper before you start.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Don't underestimate the damage of envy and jealousy.
✓ 地道说法：Don't underestimate how much envy can hurt you.
用 envy 一个词更口语，避免堆砌。
✕ 直译腔：The time you spend on the side job can bring direct results to your main job.
✓ 地道说法：Make your side-hustle hours pay off at work too.
用 pay off 表达「带来好处」更自然。
✓ 地道说法：It becomes a flywheel — each boosts the other.
飞轮效应在英文里就用 flywheel。
✓ 地道说法：Make sure there's no hole in your reasoning.
loophole 偏法律漏洞，逻辑上用 hole in the reasoning。
shifts: 先检验三个前提再动手
副业偷偷做，藏得越深越好
时间复用，让副业时间反哺主业
激励相容，互相促进成飞轮
footer_notes: ASR 校正：「低乎」校正为「低估」、「非轮效应」校正为「飞轮效应」、「主人工」相关口误已按语境修正；「一个人就是一支队伍」的自我案例保留原文。
